title: UNDERCROFT HUB POLISH
why: Critic on the o-00l pictures (hub 2 of 5): glow discs with hard rims, a welcome toast stacked on the station prompt and the stash sign, three money styles in the corner, a second plate for the experimental caption. Watch: the glow around each station fades out, the welcome toast sits under the title, the stash and bag $ figures are as big as the credits, the experimental caption is inside the last pour sign.
now: the undercroft hub reads cleanly: soft station glow, the toast under the title, one money style, one sign plate for the bar.

edits.replacement: el.innerHTML='\x24'+c+''+x+' XP STASH \x24'+sv.toLocaleString()+' BAG \x24'+bv.toLocaleString(); // v36.xx (cw-hubpolish), critic on o-00l: "money ($) type varies between stations". The stash and bag values were 16px 600 beside the 24px 800 credits; all three $ values are the one number style now, the words stash and bag stay the quiet label.
